scope: Bounded write/change/restore preparation for exact VDensHO1 / 20C2 / SW03 maintenance configuration. Reset paths remain excluded.

0x5723.access: read+write (same global Vitosoft event; exact VDensHO1 generated catalog is deduplicated to the diagnostic read presentation)

0x5724.access: read+write status enum in generated catalog
0x5724.caveat: A separate Vitosoft write-only reset event exists at the same address. Do not write this address during the configuration probe.

0x756C.interpretation: custom reference-time storage; not a plain month counter

0x7570.interpretation: custom reference storage; not proven as a plain hour counter

probe_plan.required_sequence: baseline reads -> write 24 -> readback and side-effect reads -> restore 0 -> final reads
probe_plan.stop_condition: Do not proceed to phase B if 0x5724 becomes nonzero, either counter changes unexpectedly, write/readback fails, or restore-to-zero is not confirmed.

probe_plan.required_sequence: baseline reads -> write raw 100 -> readback and side-effect reads -> restore raw 0 -> final reads
probe_plan.stop_condition: Do not run until 0x5724 reset behavior and 0x7570 LastBurnerCheck side effects are bounded.

excluded_operations: No Home Assistant command topic until live change/readback/restore semantics are verified.

conclusions: 0x5723 is locally verified read/write for the source-backed 0..24 month range.
0x756C changed to a little-endian Unix-seconds reference timestamp on both setting changes.
0x756C is therefore not a plain elapsed-month integer.
0x5724 stayed at Grundzustand and 0x7570 stayed zero.
The transition back to 00 updated both maintenance reference registers.
0x7570 stores a burner-runtime reference matching the total-runtime register within two seconds.

reset_source.behavior: If maintenance is performed before the service indication appears, set coding 24:1 and then 24:0; maintenance parameters for burner hours and time interval start again at zero.
reset_source.separation: Resetting total burner operating hours, burner starts and consumption is a separate optional service operation.
reset_source.implication: A bounded 0x5724 1 -> 0 sequence is source-backed as the maintenance-interval reset path; total counters should be monitored but must not be intentionally reset.

next_probe.expected_research_value: If 0x7570 snapshots 0x08A7 when 24 is reset, LastBurnerCheck can be modeled as current total burner runtime minus stored maintenance baseline.
